Name: Fortnite Fish 1.6
Author: Blue6erry
Description:
This mod brings in all 65 fish from Fortnite into the world of Stardew Valley. Every possible location has at least one unique fish (sadly, the Molten Spicy Fish wasn't allowed to live on Floor 100 of the mines, so he has been moved to the Caldera).

This mod should be compatible with all other fish and expansion mods, please tell me if there is something I might have missed. 

Considering the fish all have many different requirements for these fish, I would strongly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]. I also have a cheat sheet in the Articles section if you wanted to use that instead. Lookup Anything sadly doesn't quite get it right for every fish, so it might be necessary to look at the cheat sheet (Also, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url] to make sure you're not wasting your time). The fish that Lookup Anything doesn't get right are Vendetta Flopper, Midas Flopper, Snowy Flopper, Sky Blue Spicy Fish, Orange Cuddle Fish, and Blinky Flopper.

This was a lot of work and I am bound to have made a mistake somewhere, so please feel free to report any bugs and I will get them fixed asap! I went on a hiatus after finishing the 1.5 version and never got to fully playtest it. Now, after updating to 1.6, bugs are very possible.

I am open to suggestions and cool ideas, hit me with them.



Screenshots include SVE, More New Fish, and Visible Fish.

Massive thank you to the modding wiki. Also to tiakall, Selph, and atravita in the Discord for helping me troubleshoot.



If there is another bug and I haven't replied in months, you do not need my permission to release a fixed version. I feel terrible for letting the original be dead for so long.
